newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan banks weaken in afternoon trade.
newsitem.headline: Japan banks weaken in afternoon trade.

text.p: Japanese banking shares weakened in Wednesday afternoon trade, as profit-taking set in after the sector was bought at the start of the morning session, brokers said.

As of 0432 GMT, shares of Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd were down 20 yen at 2,070, in trade of 4.028 million shares. It was the second most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
Fuji Bank Ltd fell 20 yen to 1,550. It was the fourth most heavily traded issue in trade of 3.728 million shares.
Banks started out fairly strong led by dealers, but investors were slow in following up, forcing dealers to sell to avoid losses, a trader at a foreign brokerage said.

"The consensus is mixed about whether bank shares have been bought back enough or if there is still more buying in store and that is making investors reluctant to buy the sector," a broker at a "Big Four" brokerage said.
